name: Arduino Mega 2560
description: Heavyweight powerhouse brain with 54 digital I/O pins, 16 analog inputs, 4 hardware UART serial ports, and 256KB flash memory.
realWorldAnalogy: Heavyweight powerhouse brain with 54 digital I/O pins, 16 analog inputs, 4 hardware UART serial ports, and 256KB flash memory.

hazards: Support the board firmly when plugging shields into extended headers

wiringGuidance: Connect via USB-B cable. Use hardware serial ports Serial1 (pins 18/19), Serial2 (16/17), or Serial3 (14/15) for multi-device communication without software emulation.
commonMistakes: Connecting SPI peripherals to pins 10-13 instead of Mega hardware SPI pins 50 (MISO), 51 (MOSI), 52 (SCK), 53 (SS).
Exceeding power limits when running multiple motors directly.

miniExperiment.title: Mega Multi-Serial Echo
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor prints board specifications every 2 seconds.
